name: Kolmilammi Dance Pavilion
description: A wooden tanssilava by Kolmilammi pond. Live humppa and tango on summer Sundays, and an ice-cream kiosk by the gate.
greeting: The band is tuning up: accordion, bass, drums.

hello: Welcome to the lava! Tickets here.
Tonight's band plays tango till midnight.
Dance shoes? Wellies are fine too.
broke: No money, no dance, I'm afraid.
refuse: The band's packing up, come back next week.
dance: Lovely tango. Same time next week?
You again? The band is starting to recognise you.
work: What a night! They want an encore next week.
Three tangos and a humppa medley. The floor was full.
A grandmother asked for your autograph. On a napkin.
You were a little flat in the second verse. Nobody noticed. I noticed.
hired: Welcome to the band! Wear something shiny.
The stage is yours. Don't trip on the cables.
ice_cream: Another one? I won't tell your mother.

lines: You squeeze the accordion. It wheezes like a moose with a cold. Arvo winces.
The accordion has a sticker on it: "Ryttylä Tango Champion 1979". The sticker is the youngest part of it.

actions.label: Dance at the lava
actions.description: Humppa, tango and a summer night.

do.message: Your feet are still sore from last time. You dance one slow tango and spend the rest of the night on the bench.
The band plays the exact same set as last time. So does the man who always asks everyone to dance.
You dance humppa until your shirt is soaked.
Someone asks you for a second tango. Your heart skips.
You step on three different feet. Nobody minds.

then.message: A second cone. Brain freeze! You stand by the pond holding your forehead while a duck judges you.

else.message: Blueberry ice cream by the pond. Summer in one cone.
